quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Giving up on an outcome, not with anger but with quiet acceptance, points to a specific, settled feeling.
quests.explanation: Quietly accepting that something you once wanted simply isn't coming is the heart of feeling resigned.
quests.textToSpeak: I stopped expecting an apology a long time ago. At this point, I've just made my peace with never getting one.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Strangers going out of their way to return something meaningful, with no benefit to themselves, points to a deep feeling.
quests.explanation: Strangers making real effort to return something meaningful, expecting nothing back, is a genuine reason to feel touched.
quests.textToSpeak: The new tenants found our old family photos behind the water heater during their renovation and mailed every single one back to us, with a note saying they thought we'd want them.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Comparing today's challenge to tougher ones you've already navigated successfully points to a settled mindset.
quests.explanation: Comparing a current challenge to harder ones you've already navigated well is a clear, grounded confidence.
quests.textToSpeak: I've mediated harder disputes than this with far less goodwill in the room. Whatever happens in there, I know how to steer it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone far less experienced catching what several experienced people physically missed points to admiration.
quests.explanation: Someone less experienced catching what multiple experienced people missed entirely is a genuine cause of being impressed.
quests.textToSpeak: The apprentice noticed, from across the workshop, a stress fracture in the beam that three of us had walked past and touched with our own hands.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An action that helps people who need it while devastating someone who once helped you points to a torn feeling.
quests.explanation: Helping people who need it while devastating someone who once helped you is a genuine, painful conflict.
quests.textToSpeak: Testifying protects the tenants who are still living there. It also means the landlord who gave my family a chance when no one else would loses everything.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An extremely reliable, long-standing habit breaking without any explanation points to a specific unease.
quests.explanation: A years-long, extremely reliable habit suddenly breaking is a natural, well-founded cause of worry.
quests.textToSpeak: My uncle, who's called every Sunday without fail for eleven years, didn't call yesterday and hasn't called today either.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Choosing not to measure your life against a bigger alternative, in a genuinely good moment, points to a calm feeling.
quests.explanation: Not measuring a good moment against a bigger alternative you passed up reflects real contentment.
quests.textToSpeak: We could have a bigger place by now if we'd made different choices. Watching the kids ride bikes in this cul-de-sac tonight, I wasn't thinking about any of that.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Contributing something equally valuable that simply doesn't get the same recognition points to a complicated feeling.
quests.explanation: Contributing something equally valuable that never gets the same recognition is an honest form of jealousy.
quests.textToSpeak: My brother gets to be 'the one who moved abroad and made it.' I'm the one who stayed and kept the family business running. Both mattered. Only one gets talked about at dinners.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone preserving something meaningful from a person they never even met points to a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Someone preserving something meaningful from a person they never knew, purely for others, is a deep cause of gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: My daughter-in-law learned to cook my late wife's recipes from a notebook she found, just so the grandchildren would still know the taste of it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Accepting a ceiling on something you once hoped for, without ongoing bitterness, points to a settled feeling.
quests.explanation: Accepting a limit on something you once hoped for, without ongoing bitterness, is the essence of resignation.
quests.textToSpeak: This is likely as senior as I'll get here, and I've stopped letting that bother me the way it used to. It is what it is.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Watching someone use guidance you never had, to succeed where you once struggled, brings a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Watching your child succeed using guidance you never had yourself is a deep, specific pride.
quests.textToSpeak: My daughter negotiated her own salary this year, using almost word for word the advice I wished someone had given me at her age.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Fixating on a reassuring word, rereading it more than anything else, points to a restless, ongoing unease.
quests.explanation: Fixating on one reassuring word, rereading it obsessively, is a familiar and specific form of anxiety.
quests.textToSpeak: The consultant's report used the word 'manageable' four separate times. I've read those four sentences more than the rest of the document combined.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: So many separate responsibilities competing for attention that basic memory starts to fail points to a flooded state.
quests.explanation: Taking on so many competing responsibilities that basic memory starts to slip is a clear sign of being overwhelmed.
quests.textToSpeak: Between his medications, my own job, and now the school calling about my daughter, I stood in the pharmacy line and genuinely could not remember which of the three things I'd come in for.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A glossy promise that doesn't match a visible, recent cut in actual resources tends to raise doubt.
quests.explanation: A polished promise contradicted by a visible, recent cut in resources is a well-founded skepticism.
quests.textToSpeak: The care home's brochure describes 'personalized attention for every resident,' printed the same year they reduced night staff from four people to one.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A rare, hard-to-arrange reunion actually happening after years apart points to a warm, full feeling.
quests.explanation: A rare family reunion finally happening after years of scattered lives is a full, simple happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: All four of my children, now grown and scattered across three countries, were in the same kitchen at the same time for the first time in six years.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: People from your distant past coming forward, unprompted, to name something specific you gave them points to a deep feeling.
quests.explanation: People from your past coming forward unprompted, to name something specific you gave them, is a profound feeling of being touched.
quests.textToSpeak: At the retirement dinner, four different former students I hadn't spoken to in over a decade stood up, uninvited, to say what one specific lesson had done for their lives.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A specific reassurance that shaped a real decision, later proven wrong, points to a deflated feeling.
quests.explanation: A specific reassurance that shaped a real decision, later proven false, is a sharp, justified disappointment.
quests.textToSpeak: I turned down the transfer because they promised the merger wouldn't affect my role. Six months later, my role is the one that no longer exists.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Allowing yourself to plan for a future event, without a guarantee, points to a forward-looking feeling.
quests.explanation: Allowing yourself to plan for something months away, without a guarantee, is a grounded, meaningful hope.
quests.textToSpeak: Nobody's using the word 'cured.' But my son asked to sign up for the football season that starts in the spring, and we let him.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A conflict that's stopped being actively fought and has instead settled into a routine points to a specific feeling.
quests.explanation: An unresolved conflict settling into a quiet, avoided routine, rather than being fought, is a clear resignation.
quests.textToSpeak: We don't fight about it anymore. We just quietly go to separate rooms when the subject comes up, and that's become its own kind of normal.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone new and young succeeding where long-established people had failed for years points to admiration.
quests.explanation: Someone new succeeding where established people failed for years is a genuine cause of being impressed.
quests.textToSpeak: The community organizer, twenty-three years old and new to the neighborhood, got the council to reverse a decision that longtime residents had failed to touch for a decade.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Repeated attempts that keep failing for a new, never-before-mentioned reason each time point to a stuck feeling.
quests.explanation: Repeated attempts that fail for a new, unmentioned reason every single time is a deep, ongoing frustration.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Protecting a long, valued loyalty at the cost of someone else's right to know something important points to a torn feeling.
quests.explanation: Weighing a long-standing loyalty against someone else's right to important information is a genuine, difficult conflict.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone quietly absorbing the emotional cost of your slow progress, without ever showing it, points to a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Someone absorbing the emotional cost of your slow progress, without ever showing it, is a quiet, deep gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: My physical therapist has never once, in two years of slow progress, let slip even a flicker of the frustration I know this pace must cost her.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Being widely known professionally while remaining genuinely unknown personally points to a quiet, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: Being widely known professionally while remaining truly unknown personally is a quiet, modern loneliness.
quests.textToSpeak: Everyone at these industry dinners knows my work. Almost none of them know anything true about me. I've stopped noticing the difference most nights.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Choosing to stay with a decision's real costs, without regret, points to a calm, settled feeling.
quests.explanation: Living comfortably with the real costs of a choice, without wishing you'd chosen differently, reflects genuine contentment.
quests.textToSpeak: The house is smaller and the garden is more work than either of us expected at this age. Neither of us has once talked about moving back to the city.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Repeating an action that has no real effect on an outcome you can't control points to a restless, ongoing feeling.
quests.explanation: Repeating an action that can't actually change an uncontrollable outcome is a familiar form of anxiety.
quests.textToSpeak: Nothing about the biopsy schedule has changed. I've still rearranged that week's calendar three separate times as though rearranging it changes anything.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Watching someone manage something enormous, in an area that once overwhelmed them completely, brings a specific, warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Watching someone manage something enormous in an area that once overwhelmed them is a deep, specific pride.
quests.textToSpeak: My youngest, who once needed three adults in the room just to attempt a spelling test, read the eulogy at her grandfather's funeral alone, start to finish, without pausing.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: No longer preparing for an outcome you've fully stopped expecting points to a settled, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: No longer preparing for an outcome you've genuinely stopped expecting is the clearest form of resignation.
quests.textToSpeak: I used to rehearse what I'd say if he ever called. I don't rehearse it anymore. I just don't expect the call.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A group making real, visible effort at something difficult, purely as a gesture for you, points to a deep feeling.
quests.explanation: A group making real, visible effort at something difficult, purely as a gesture, is a profound feeling of being touched.
quests.textToSpeak: The whole choir learned the one song in my late husband's language, just the one, just for the service, none of them able to pronounce half the words correctly, all of them trying anyway.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A small, ordinary sign of normal life returning, amid a much larger recovery, points to a forward-looking feeling.
quests.explanation: A small, ordinary sign of everyday life returning, amid a larger recovery, is a grounded and moving hope.
quests.textToSpeak: The rebuild is maybe a third done. Someone hung actual curtains in the window of the corner unit this week, and it's the first thing on that block that's looked like a home again.
